description: Undo changes made through discord-mcp, from their records: builds, and any single create, edit, or delete of a channel or role, permission edit, role given or taken, server settings edit. Use this rather than redoing things by hand: it has an exact copy of what was there. It deletes what a change created, puts back what it changed, and recreates what it deleted. A setting goes back only if it still holds the value the change set; anything changed since stays and is reported. Recreated items get new ids, and a deleted channel's messages cannot come back. Pass change_id for one change, since (a time) to undo every change made from then on, such as everything today, or change_ids for several; they are undone newest first. With none, the latest change not yet undone. The first call changes nothing and returns every step plus a confirm_token; repeat with the token to run it. If a step fails (a rate limit, say), calling it again finishes the rest.

change_id.description: One change, from list_changes or the tool that made it.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

since.description: ISO date-time: undo every change made at or after it.

name: undo_change
title: Undo change
